repository.pathListFormat: the selection output: one path per line, LF-terminated, in Git tree order

cases.crlfRule: a *.crlf.go.txt case is committed with LF endings and observed with every LF widened to CRLF
cases.emptyRule: empty-file.go.txt is zero bytes and is not committed, because CEM 1.0 cannot bind an empty-file creation (CEM-V1-300); both harnesses declare it and observe it as zero bytes at its sorted path

observation.order: one JSON line per regular file, in path order
observation.file: path, source sha256, and the sha256 of the scanner token stream (offset, kind, literal), the go/ast.Fprint dump with object resolution filtered, the go/printer output and the go/format.Source output, plus whether formatting is idempotent; a failing step records error:<sha256 of the error text>, and print is empty when parsing fails
observation.pair: kind, image segments of the base file ({s, e} byte range or {t} text), image sha256, and eight verdict bits, two per predicate in the order formatter-only, import-reorder, move, rename: first forward (base to image), then reverse (image to base)

perturbations.formatter-only: two blank lines after the package clause line
perturbations.import-reorder: the first two specs of the first parenthesized import declaration swapped, when neither carries a comment
perturbations.move: the first two adjacent top-level functions swapped, doc comments included
perturbations.rename: the first unexported top-level function without a receiver (not init, main or _) renamed to cemCorpusRenamed, or cemCorpusRenamed<n> when that word already occurs, in every identifier token and every non-directive comment
perturbations.partial-rename: only that function's declaring name renamed, when the name is used again (a near-miss)
